title: Compact quickstart cheatsheet canvas for developer onboarding (auth, streaming, tool-calls)
creator: Asha Nair
description: Design and deliver a compact, single-canvas cheatsheet asset for API/SDK quickstarts. The asset is intended for: 1) SDK quickstart docs (first-run header), 2) in-console 'Start here' card, and 3) marketing one-pager. The canvas consists of four horizontally stacked micro-panels: Auth (key creation + rotation microcopy), Shortcode snippet (single call example for REST+JS+Python), Streaming wire (progressive frames and stream diffs), and Tool-call map (function signature -> expected JSON response). Each panel must be legible at 600px width and accessible at AA contrast. Deliverables: layered Figma file, exported PNGs @1x/2x, accessible alt text, short Lottie hint for streaming animation, and a compressed GIF demo for lightweight docs embedding.
acceptance_criteria: Figma canvas with named layers for each micro-panel and notes for dev handoff
Alt text strings provided for each exported asset and inline copy reviewed by Content
Contrast checks pass AA for text >=14px; color tokens match design system
Animation prototype for streaming shows partial tokens appending in <=3s loop
Design ready for console integration: 1x CSS spec and 3 asset sizes
design_notes: Focus on a 'single-scan' learning moment: developers should be able to read the cheat panel in under 12 seconds
Auth panel uses two-step microflow: create key -> copy -> rotate example. Use muted red for expired-state and green for success state
Streaming panel uses a progressive reveal with a subtle typing cursor and token color delta to illustrate streaming vs non-streaming cost/latency tradeoff
Tool-call map visualizes function name and three fields of response as compact cards. Include a small badge showing 'structured output supported'
Prefer vector shapes and text for PNG clarity; Lottie only for streaming micro-animation; avoid embedding live tokens or keys in visuals
Provide two layout variants: left-to-right (docs header) and stacked vertical (mobile docs and console drawer)
